description: Source code for FastAPI route handlers managing event creation, listing, retrieval, and weather-based recommendations in the Event Planner backend. Includes endpoints for scoring and generating recommendations based on weather data.

methods.name: EventResponse create_event(payload: EventRequest, repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo))
methods.description: Handles creation of a new event, stores it in the in-memory repository, and logs email notification stubs.

methods.name: List[EventResponse] list_events( userId: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter events by associated user ID"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: Retrieves list of stored events, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: EventResponse get_event( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event by its ID, raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: RecommendationResponse get_recommendations( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: Returns placeholder weather-aware recommendations for a given event.

methods.name: ScoreResponse score_event_date(payload: ScoreRequest)
methods.description: Scores weather suitability for specified date/location by building time windows and analyzing forecast data. Uses external weather APIs.

methods.name: RecommendationResponse post_recommendations(payload: RecommendationRequest)
methods.description: Generates real-time weather-aware recommendations for an ad-hoc event without persisting it.
